create.name: Gabriella Giubilaro
create.bio:
Gabriella Giubilaro is a senior teacher of Iyengar Yoga based in Florence, where she founded the Istituto Iyengar Yoga Firenze. She took up yoga in Florence in 1973 under Dona Holleman and, after completing a doctorate in physics, chose to give her working life to the method of B.K.S. Iyengar. From the early 1980s she has travelled to Pune most years to study with Iyengar and with his children Geeta and Prashant, and she holds the Junior Advanced level of certification. She has run her own Florence studio since 1987.

She still teaches a full week at the institute on Via San Gervasio: studio classes, an advanced group, classes for older students shared with colleagues, and online sessions in Italian and English that include pranayama and a class for teachers. Her teaching is known for clear, practical instruction that helps each student work intelligently with their own body. She trains Iyengar teachers on residential weekends at the Montauto farm near Rapolano Terme in Tuscany, leads summer intensives there with guest senior teachers, and gives seminars across Europe and further afield, from Scandinavia and Ireland to Brazil, Argentina, Dubai and China.

courses.title: Teachers Training Workshop – Level 2 & 3 – Montauto
courses.description: Two residential weekends for certified Iyengar teachers at a Tuscan farm near Rapolano Terme, taught in Italian and English. The work rounds off the postures of each level and begins preparation for its assessment, with special attention to observing and adjusting students.
courses.price: € 360 (€ 140 for the classes and € 220 for accommodation and food)
